set.body:
Raised by independent review while preparing evidence for Epic 8. This is a hard blocker at exactly the scale Epic 8 must certify.

REPRODUCTION - identity metric, the feature-additive FAST path

  volume_domain(array(TRUE, c(50,40,25)), spacing = c(3,3,3))   p = 50000
  obs = 96, q = 4, two runs, searchlights radius 6.1mm

  lm_relation_fit          1.7s   ok
  compile_frame(r=6mm)     1.2s   ok    nnz = 1557872, mean support 31.2
  plan_geometry           55.9s   FAILED
      vector memory limit of 36.0 Gb reached
      sparse->dense coercion: allocating vector of size 18.6 GiB

18.6 GiB is exactly 50000^2 * 8 bytes, i.e. p^2 doubles.

CAUSE - traced, not inferred

R/measurement.R:490

  .additive_frame_signature <- function(frame) {
    .validate_frame_for_compile(frame)
    semantic <- list(
      representation = frame$representation,
      weights = as.matrix(frame$weights),      # <- densifies the p x p sparse frame
      ...
    )
    paste0("sha256:", digest::digest(semantic, algo = "sha256", serialize = TRUE))
  }

The sparse searchlight frame is coerced to dense purely so it can be serialized and hashed. Nothing computational needs the dense form.

FREQUENCY - it is not once

Five call sites: geometry-plan.R:154, metric.R:633, metric.R:841, measurement.R:513, measurement-decomposition.R:78. Instrumented on a small fixture:

  calls during plan_geometry     : 1
  calls during evaluate_geometry : 3

So a single contrast at 50k voxels attempts the 18.6 GiB allocation four times; it dies on the first. metric.R:633 is inside .compose_frame_metric, so the dense-metric path would attempt it per composition.

FIX - exact, and strictly better as a signature

Hash the sparse structure instead of the dense matrix. For the dgCMatrix the canonical content is @i, @p, @x, @Dim, which Matrix keeps in sorted column-compressed form, so it is a stable canonical identity. Measured on realistic searchlight sparsity:

  p= 8000  nnz= 158245  dense  0.5 GiB   sparse triplet hash  1.8 MB   265x smaller
  p=20000  nnz= 395714  dense  3.0 GiB   sparse triplet hash  4.6 MB   663x smaller
  p=50000  nnz= 988904  dense 18.6 GiB   sparse triplet hash 11.5 MB  1657x smaller

This also makes the signature representation-independent rather than accidentally tied to densification.

WHY p0

- Epic 8 gates on 4 GiB peak incremental RSS and 30 minutes for one contrast at a 50-60k fixture. The planning stage alone needs 18.6 GiB before any numerical work, so the gate cannot be met or even measured.
- Epic 9 depends on Epic 8.
- This is on the IDENTITY-metric feature-additive path, the cheapest route in the system. The dense local metric path is strictly worse.
- The existing 50k scale test passes because it exercises .euclidean_support_index directly and never builds a frame signature, so nothing currently catches this.

RELATED: wall time is also superlinear on this path - 3.4s, 6.4s, 13.6s, 48.0s at p = 1000, 2197, 4096, 8000, roughly p^1.8. Extrapolating gives ~19 minutes at 50k for q=4, which is inside the 30-minute gate but with no headroom for realistic q. Worth measuring properly once the memory blocker is gone.
set.title: plan_geometry hard-fails at 50k voxels: additive_frame_signature densifies the sparse frame to hash it (18.6 GiB)
